internalToolIds.addFooter: Footer half of the one HeaderFooterDialog: AddHeader, AddFooter and AddPageNumbers share a single case (PagesController.cpp:115-125). Covered by `addHeader` (Insert > Header & Footer, S57). Never had its own ribbon/menu entry even in the shipped app.
internalToolIds.comment: Duplicate of `note`: ToolId::Note and ToolId::Comment both map to ToolMode::AddComment (EditController.cpp:130-131). Covered by Sticky Note (Home > Annotate, Review > Comments).
internalToolIds.editImage: Same case as `image`: both call enterImageEditMode() (EditController.cpp:157-160). Covered by `editObject` (Edit > Objects) plus the Image contextual tab, but only after a controller change (see report, section 3).
internalToolIds.freehand: Duplicate of `pencil`: ToolId::Pencil and ToolId::Freehand both map to ToolMode::DrawFreehand (EditController.cpp:126-127). Covered by Pen (Draw > Ink).
internalToolIds.printPreview: Merged into `print`: the File > Print Backstage page has the live preview (S32); COVERAGE.md B8 maps the old menu item there.
internalToolIds.selectObj: Duplicate of `editObject`: ToolId::SelectObject and ToolId::EditObject both map to ToolMode::EditObject (EditController.cpp:120-121). Covered by `editObjects`.

_meta.rule: Command ids ARE the canonical ToolId strings (plan 06 7.1). Metadata only: no handlers.
